# Shelfmark Ltd (ShelfmarkLTD) — Corporate Overview & Knowledge Base

> Shelfmark LTD is a premier UK registered corporate entity, top England e-commerce store seller, B2B wholesale distributor, and private label product manufacturer located in Wolverhampton, United Kingdom.

## Core Services & Specializations
1. **Top UK E-Commerce Wholesaler**: Supplying over 600 catalog items across 15 store departments (Electronics, Fashion, Home & Living, Furniture, Beauty, Grocery, Baby & Kids, Sports, Books, Pet Supplies, Gaming, Jewelry, Garden, Tools, Health).
2. **Top England Private Label Manufacturer**: Providing custom brand logo printing, bespoke retail packaging design, EAN barcode registration, and UKCA compliance certification.
3. **Wolverhampton Logistics Hub**: Same-day UK mainland dispatch, palleted freight shipping, and Amazon FBA warehousing prep.
